description: Details submitted pursuant to reference 25/00638/FUL: landscaping (5) and construction management plan (7) in respect of sub-division of site and erection of an end-of-terraced 2-storey dwelling house.
decision_conditions: The details submitted are insufficient to satisfy the discharge of condition 7 (Construction Management Plan) of planning permission ref: 25/00638/FUL as inadequate details of construction vehicles/ plant have been provided, including their weight and frequency of movement. In addition, no swept path analysis or highway condition survey has been provided. The proposal is therefore contrary to Section 12 and 15 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policies T4 of the London Plan (2024), CP24 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), DMD47 and DMD49 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014) and GLA: London Sustainable Design and Construction SPG (2014).
